entries.title: Jeremiah 48:1
segments: ¶Concerning Moab. Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled; Kirjathaim is put to shame, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and dismayed.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:2
segments: Moab's praise is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: Come, and let us cut her off from [being] a nation. Thou also, O Madmen, shalt be cut down; the sword shall pursue thee.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:3
segments: A voice of crying from Horonaim; wasting and great destruction!

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:4
segments: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:5
segments: For by the ascent of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the descent of Horonaim is heard the anguish of the cry of destruction.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:6
segments: Flee, save your lives, and be like a shrub in the wilderness.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:7
segments: For because thou hast confided in thy works and in thy treasures, thou also shalt be taken, and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:8
segments: And the waster shall come upon every city, that not a city shall escape; and the valley shall perish, and the plateau shall be destroyed: as Jehovah hath said.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:9
segments: Give wings unto Moab, that she may flee and get away; and the cities thereof shall become a desolation, without inhabitant.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:10
segments: Cursed be he that doeth the work of Jehovah negligently, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood!

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:11
segments: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and hath settled on his lees; he hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste hath remained in him, and his scent is not changed.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:12
segments: Therefore behold, days come, saith Jehovah, that I will send unto him pourers that shall pour him off, and shall empty his vessels, and break in pieces his flagons.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:13
segments: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:14
segments: ¶How do ye say, We are mighty, and men of valour for the war?

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:15
segments: Moab is laid waste, and his cities are gone up [in smoke], and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is Jehovah of hosts.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:16
segments: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:17
segments: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:18
segments: Come down from [thy] glory and sit in the drought, O inhabitress, daughter of Dibon; the spoiler of Moab is come up against thee, thy strongholds hath he destroyed.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:19
segments: Stand by the way, and watch, inhabitress of Aroer; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth; say, What is done?

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:20
segments: Moab is put to shame; for he is broken down: howl and cry; tell it in Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:21
segments: And judgment is come upon the country of the plateau; upon Holon, and upon Jahzah, and upon Mephaath;

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:22
segments: and upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim;

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:23
segments: and upon Kirjathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon;

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:24
segments: and upon Kerijoth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far and near.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:25
segments: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:26
segments: Make him drunken, for he magnified himself against Jehovah; and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:27
segments: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? Was he found among thieves, that as oft as thou didst speak of him, thou didst shake the head?

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:28
segments: Leave the cities, and dwell in the rocks, ye inhabitants of Moab, and be like the dove, that maketh her nest in the sides of the cave's mouth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:29
segments: We have heard of the arrogance of Moab, --[he is] very proud; --his loftiness, and his arrogance, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:30
segments: I know his wrath, saith Jehovah; his pratings are vain: they do not as [they say].

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:31
segments: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab: for the men of Kir-heres shall there be moaning.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:32
segments: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with more than the weeping of Jaazer: thy shoots passed over the sea, they reached to the sea of Jaazer. The spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:33
segments: And joy and gladness is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: they shall no more tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:34
segments: Because of the cry from Heshbon, unto Elaleh, unto Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar unto Horonaim, [unto] Eglath-shelishijah: for even the waters of Nimrim shall become desolations.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:35
segments: And I will cause to cease in Moab, saith Jehovah, him that offereth in the high place, and him that burneth incense to his gods.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:36
segments: Therefore my heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and my heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres; because the abundance that he hath gotten is perished.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:37
segments: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped; upon all the hands are cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:38
segments: It is wholly lamentation upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the public places thereof; for I have broken Moab, like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:39
segments: They howl, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! And Moab shall be a derision and a terror to all that are round about him.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:40
segments: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread forth his wings over Moab.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:41
segments: Kerijoth is taken, and the strongholds are seized, and at that day the heart of the mighty men of Moab shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:42
segments: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:43
segments: Fear, and the pit, and the snare shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:44
segments: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon her, upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:45
segments: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon powerless; for a fire hath come forth from Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and hath consumed the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the sons of tumult.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:46
segments: Woe to thee, Moab! The people of Chemosh is undone; for thy sons are taken away in captivity, and thy daughters are captives.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:47
segments: But I will turn the captivity of Moab at the end of the days, saith Jehovah. Thus far is the judgement of Moab.
